primary_task: Apply the audit-integrity quality gate (clarification, anti-rationalization, self-critique, retry, non-negotiables, 1-10 self-reflection scoring) to one AppSec analysis run before delivering it.

requirements.name: references/*.md component files (skill-bundled)
requirements.evidence: | Clarification Protocol | [clarification-protocol.md](references/clarification-protocol.md) | ... Agents apply all 7 unless their scope excludes a specific component.

requirements.name: ask_user
requirements.evidence: **Before analysis**: Apply Clarification Protocol if scope is ambiguous
requirements.basis: "ask_user": "ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation"

requirements.name: write (lessons/memories)

notes: The skill is a reasoning/quality framework applied by the agent itself.
